keyPhrases.text: Shame! Shame on not caring about helping make theater more available
having the guts to try it first

reasoning: This is primarily a news article about ticket pricing controversy rather than a traditional theater review. The piece presents balanced coverage with both criticism (theater accessibility concerns) and support (industry innovation) for the pricing strategy. The show itself is referenced positively as a 'hit musical,' but the focus is on business practices rather than artistic merit.
